## 4. A stored bit has sharp resource laws

Now let

\[
X\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(p),\qquad
Y\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(q),
\qquad p,q\in(0,1).
\]

For a procedure \(A\), define

\[
\delta_A(p,q)=\Pr_A(X\ne Y).
\]

The unavoidable disagreement with known probabilities is \(|p-q|\). The additional disturbance caused by the information restriction is therefore

\[
R(A)
=
\sup_{p,q}
\left[\delta_A(p,q)-|p-q|\right].
\]

Output exactness is maintained throughout. The quantity being reduced is **extra alteration of the stored bit**.

### Optimal uniform expected budget

For every integer \(L\ge1\), put \(C=2L-1\). Then

\[
\boxed{
\inf_{A:\,\sup_{p,q}\mathbb E_A[N_p+N_q]\le C}
R(A)
=
\frac{1}{C+1}.
}
\]

This solves the uniform expected-budget problem at every odd budget.

### Optimal hard cap

For every integer \(m\ge1\), put

\[
n=\left\lfloor\frac{m+1}{2}\right\rfloor.
\]

Then

\[
\boxed{
\inf_{A:\,N_p+N_q\le m\;\text{almost surely}}
R(A)
=
\frac{\binom{2n}{n}}{4^n}.
}
\]

The lower bound covers arbitrary adaptive choices between the two sources and arbitrary parameter-independent auxiliary randomness.

An immediate consequence is that consecutive odd and even caps have the same minimax value. The extra single draw at an even cap cannot improve this universal worst-case objective.

Since

\[
\frac{\binom{2n}{n}}{4^n}
\sim
\frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi n}},
\]

the optimal costs for uniformly guaranteeing

\[
\delta_A(p,q)\le |p-q|+\eta
\]

obey

\[
\text{expected budget}\sim\eta^{-1},
\qquad
\text{hard cap}\sim\frac{2}{\pi\eta^2}.
\]

For the following tolerances, the expected budgets fall exactly on the solved odd-budget frontier. The hard caps are the smallest valid integers.

| Maximum extra disagreement \(\eta\) | Optimal uniform mean budget | Minimum hard cap |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 10% | 9 | 63 |
| 5% | 19 | 255 |
| 1% | 99 | 6,365 |
| 0.1% | 999 | 636,619 |

At \(p=q\), \(\eta\) bounds the entire probability of changing the old bit. Away from equality, the unavoidable \(|p-q|\) remains.

## 5. The operation that attains the bounds

Both frontiers are attained by a simple excursion construction. Its core recorded-bit mechanism comes from [Astra N1415’s pinned source](https://github.com/harjassand/astra-research-knowledge/blob/02e2d5971a9ae806690e0bd4d5cc803e0c5a3030/research/2026-10-30-recorded-bit-transport-and-trace-repair/source/p1-visible/FINAL_NATIVE_PREFI

## 6. Why stronger algorithms cannot beat these laws

### The information bound

Let \(N_p,N_q\) count fresh old and target queries, and write

\[
D=Y-X,\qquad
\Delta=q-p,\qquad
\operatorname{Var}(D)=\delta-\Delta^2.
\]

For every universally exact procedure with finite expected query counts at an interior parameter pair,

\[
\boxed{
\delta-(q-p)^2
\ge
\frac{p(1-p)}{1+\mathbb E N_p}
+
\frac{q(1-q)}{\mathbb E N_q}.
}
\]

The \(1\) accounts for information already carried by the stored old bit.

Consequently, if \(C=\mathbb E(N_p+N_q)\),

\[
\delta-(q-p)^2
\ge
\frac{
\left(\sqrt{p(1-p)}+\sqrt{q(1-q)}\right)^2
}{C+1}.
\]

At equal laws,

\[
\boxed{\delta(C+1)\ge4\theta(1-\theta).}
\]

At the fair pair this becomes \(\delta(C+1)\ge1\), which supplies the expected-budget minimax lower bound. The spatial walk attains equality.

I used a stopped-transcript relative-entropy proof. If \(\mathsf P_{p,q}\) denotes the complete stopped-transcript law, then

\[
\operatorname{KL}(\mathsf P_{p,q}\Vert\mathsf P_{p',q'})
=
(1+\mathbb E N_p)\operatorname{kl}(p\Vert p')
+
\mathbb E N_q\operatorname{kl}(q\Vert q').
\]

Exactness fixes \(\mathbb E D=q-p\). A local entropy inequality for this bounded observable converts changes in that mean into the variance bound above.

Sequential information bounds are established Bernoulli-factory machinery. The direct entropy argument matters because unrestricted differentiation through stopping-time expansions can fail; it avoids that regularity gap here. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}

### The hard-cap lower bound

The decisive reduction is to the parameter line

\[
q=1-p.
\]

On this line, every requested old bit can be supplied by a fresh \(\operatorname{Bernoulli}(p)\) bit, and every requested target bit by its complement. Adaptive oracle choice therefore becomes an experiment on a single underlying coin.

Pad unused queries to the hard cap \(m\). Including \(X\), there are

\[
N=m+1
\]

independent underlying bits. Let \(K\) be their total.

Conditional on \(K=k\), their ordering is uniform and independent of \(p\). Universal exactness forces

\[
\mathbb E[Y\mid K=k]=1-\frac{k}{N},
\]

by uniqueness of the Bernstein representation of the function \(1-p\). Exchangeability gives

\[
\mathbb E[X\mid K=k]=\frac{k}{N}.
\]

Therefore

\[
\Pr(X\ne Y\mid K=k)

Finite precision changes literal equality. Quantized measurements have atoms; approximate displacement is a different objective.
The solved budget classes are precise. The binary hard-cap frontier is complete for every integer cap. Expected-budget sharpness is proved at odd budgets. General-space optimality is proved for fixed per-source budgets.

I regard this as a completed foundational result with provisional novelty. Its consequences for end-to-end scientific simulation or physical capability remain to be demonstrated; a civilisation-changing capability has not been established.

What has been established is that a stochastic model needs an additional description when reuse matters: the operations through which its law is accessible. That description determines whether a stored realization can be retained at all, and, for a bit, gives the exact attainable price of retaining it.
